newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ABS reveals alternatives to monthly BOPs data.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ABS reveals alternatives to monthly BOPs data.

text.p: The Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) believed it should withdraw from the publication of monthly balance of payments statistics, according to an information paper released on Monday.
However, the ABS favoured plans to continue publishing monthly merchandise exports and imports, services exports and imports, and the balance on goods and services.
It would do this on a balance of payments basis, the information paper said.
The paper contained a number of options currently under consideration, but this was the preferred one, the ABS said.
